notes: Autosave: what you type now saves on this device as you type — study material, detector text, tutor and Voice Coach drafts, and your custom rubric — so closing the tab never wipes it. A “Saved …” line under Your material shows when it last saved, and Clear saved drafts wipes it. On-device only (localStorage); nothing is uploaded.
Screen captures are still never auto-saved: if your study material holds text from a saved capture, that capture text is left out of the auto-save and your earlier saved draft stays put.

Check for updates now actually checks: it reads version.json from this site instead of a baked-in copy that could never report a newer version. If the check can't reach the site (offline, or the preview link), it says so instead of pretending.
